hero.sub: Find a workout companion or certified pro near you, book by the session, and just show up. No memberships, no lock-in, no hard sell.

items.title: Pay by the session
items.body: No annual lock-in or monthly fees you forget to cancel. Book one session at a time.

items.title: No commitment
items.body: Train once a week or once a month. Reschedule or cancel anytime — no penalties.

items.title: No hard sell
items.body: No front-desk upsells or packages. Just the session you actually asked for.

items.title: Real people nearby
items.body: Match on activity and location, see ratings, and meet someone who fits how you train.

items.title: Discover
items.body: Browse companions and pros near you, filtered by activity and what you're after.

items.title: Book a session
items.body: Pick a time and place and send a request. They accept — that's it.

items.title: Show up & train
items.body: Meet in person and train. Rate each other afterwards to keep the community strong.

kinds.intro: Whatever you need — structured coaching, an experienced partner, or just someone to show up with. Each one sets their own rate.

items.name: Certified pros
items.body: Licensed, verified trainers for structured, goal-driven coaching.

items.name: Experienced peers
items.body: Seasoned athletes who train alongside you and share what works.

items.name: Training buddies
items.body: Someone to keep you accountable and make showing up easier.
